prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The facts of the collision are clear. Your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while our client was stopped in traffic, and the responding officer documented the impact. Liability for this collision rests with your insured.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered whiplash injuries to the neck and upper back. Our client has received ongoing medical treatment, including physical therapy and chiropractic care, and continues to experience pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. Our client has also missed time from work while recovering, and the treatment records and wage documentation are enclosed with this letter.

Under these circumstances, we have calculated the full value of our client's claim, including medical expenses, lost wages, and compensation for pain and suffering. Based on this evaluation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims against your insured arising from this collision.

This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file a civil action on our client's behalf without further notice. We look forward to your prompt reply.
